answer: Colored Noise Handshake. Each new identity must solve a fresh challenge whose random seed encodes a whisper from an existing agent's signed state; replay fails because the seed differs every round. Verification requires the newcomer to produce a distinct opal-flagged nonce chain, making copied solutions worthless. An attacker pays one live challenge solve per identity, and mass registration multiplies that cost linearly, so the fable of cheap sybils collapses.
